source_title: Payment Integrity Scorecard: Federal Crop Insurance Corporation (FCIC), Q4 2025
captured_source_scope: Q4 2025 FCIC scorecard root-cause and recovery-plan text
captured_boundary_summary: The scorecard reports a FY2024 overpayment amount and separates two data-access root causes: failure to access data/information needed and inability to access data/information needed. It also describes notification, tracking, collection, and verification through RMA compliance and accounting systems. This supports the revised field framing, but it does not establish that the full reported root-cause amount is collectible savings.
closure_effect: Use as partial support for the revised USDA root-cause field; keep field closure and scoring blocked until reviewer determines whether recovery-process language is enough for recoverability treatment.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology follow-up source-capture row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

program_or_activity: Purchased Long Term Services and Supports (PLTSS)
source_title: VA Financial Policy, Volume VII, Chapter 03: Payment Integrity and Fraud Reduction
captured_source_scope: Current VA-wide payment classification and returned-funds rules cross-checked against FY2025 PLTSS reporting
captured_boundary_summary: VA policy distinguishes proper payments despite some process/documentation failures, unknown payments when evidence cannot establish recipient or amount, monetary-loss overpayments, technical/non-monetary loss, and recovery only when monetary-loss funds are returned. The PLTSS AFR supplies causes and bill-process context but no cause-to-category, debt, dispute, collectibility, or certified-collection mapping.
closure_effect: Use as a narrow agency-policy classification boundary only; keep PLTSS field closure and scoring blocked pending program-specific disposition lineage.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology follow-up source-capture row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

captured_source_scope: FY2024 CMS Medicaid improper-payment discussion and technical-improper limitation text
captured_boundary_summary: CMS reports the FY2024 Medicaid improper payment estimate and says missing or insufficient documentation payments do not necessarily represent payments to ineligible providers or beneficiaries. CMS also says 525 independently verified claims were technically improper: paid to the right recipient for the correct amount but noncompliant with process requirements. This blocks treating PERM improper-payment dollars as automatic fraud, waste, recoverable dollars, or savings.
closure_effect: Use as boundary-block support for Medicaid scoring; keep field closure and scoring blocked unless a later source provides a positive recoverable or collectible amount basis.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology follow-up source-capture row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.

source_title: Payment Integrity Scorecard: Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit (Part D), Q4 2025
captured_source_scope: Q4 2025 Part D scorecard overpayment, root-cause, and recovery-plan text
captured_boundary_summary: The scorecard reports a FY2024 overpayment amount and rate, explains drug, pricing, and insufficient-documentation causes, and states that closeout notices require plan sponsors to delete improper PDE records for named audits, resulting in recovery to Medicare Part D. This supports audit-specific recovery process language, not a collectible amount basis for the full reported overpayment estimate.
closure_effect: Use as partial Part D recovery-process support; keep field closure and scoring blocked until reviewer decides whether a full recoverable or collectible amount basis exists.
public_use_rule: Use as a methodology follow-up source-capture row only; not a savings estimate and not a finding of waste.
